column1: # agent-asset-pins.tsv — pinned SHARED agent-asset source hashes for
# deliberately deviated trusty-code copies (issue #2958 Slice E4).
# Format: <shared-source-relative-path><TAB><sha256-of-that-file>
# These 4 files are the KNOWN INTENTIONAL DEVIATIONS documented in
# crates/trusty-code/src/assets/mod.rs ("Tools-restriction deviation" /
# "Prose deviation follow-up" doc blocks, Slice E3, PR #3041): the tcode
# copy carries an added `tools:` frontmatter line plus (for three of the
# four) reworded read-only prose, so it can never be byte-identical to the
# shared asset it was derived from.
# Every OTHER agent asset is not copied at all — trusty-mpm and trusty-code
# both read the one file under content/agents/ (repo root, ADR-0064)
# via trusty_agents_common::agent_content, so there is nothing to
# pin. check_agent_assets.sh hashes the CURRENT shared source for these 4
# and compares against the pin here; if it no longer matches, the shared
# source changed behind a deliberately deviated fork and the guard fails so
# a human reconciles that fork on purpose.
# Regenerate (only after manually reconciling the trusty-code fork with the
# new shared content) with: scripts/check_agent_assets.sh --update
content/agents/code-analyzer.md
content/agents/code-critic.md
content/agents/qa.md
content/agents/web-qa.md
